column3: The Hebrew presents the fool’s speech as a completed action; BSB uses says.
The Hebrew presents looking down as completed; BSB uses looks.
The Hebrew says they have not called upon the LORD without an explicit refusal; BSB says refuse.
The Hebrew repeats the root of fear and names the righteous one’s generation; BSB says company of the righteous.
The Hebrew has a singular afflicted person and his refuge, without explicitly addressing sinners; BSB adds sinners and uses their.
